items.proposed: no IDH selection biomarker (drop B's IDH eligibility row)
items.reason: Both IDH states are eligible ('IDH wild-type glioma and IDH mutant WHO Grade Ⅲ and Ⅳ glioma'), so IDH is not an entry requirement; it only describes the eligible histologies. Not candidate-matched in any case (no drug in the trial).

note: Radiotherapy-only trial (photon + carbon ion boost), registered Phase NA, so excluded at S3 (phase_not_applicable) before S6. Agreed S6 reason no_pharmacological_candidate kept; if XL adopts excluded_intervention_type for radiotherapy-question trials (see NCT04747145, NCT07368283) it would change here too, without effect on Figure 1.
